blocks.name: register_file
blocks.responsibility: Stores and retrieves values of general-purpose registers.
blocks.design_rationale: Separating the register file allows for easier testing and verification of register operations.

blocks.name: alu
blocks.responsibility: Performs arithmetic, logical, and shift operations.
blocks.design_rationale: The ALU is a critical component for executing most instructions, and separating it simplifies the design and verification process.

blocks.name: decoder
blocks.responsibility: Decodes instructions into control signals and determines the operation type.
blocks.design_rationale: The decoder simplifies the main CPU logic by handling instruction decoding, making the design more modular and easier to verify.

blocks.name: cpu_top
blocks.responsibility: Top-level entity that instantiates other blocks and connects them together.
blocks.design_rationale: The top-level entity integrates all the components and provides a clear interface for testing and verification.

notes: This decomposition separates the CPU into distinct blocks, each with a specific responsibility. This approach enhances modularity, verifiability, and maintainability of the design.
